name: orbis-script-tooling
description: The TypeScript toolchain for the script runtime's own libraries. Not published, and not needed to use the Dart packages — only to change the TypeScript in them.

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:scene
scripts.build:ui: tsc -p packages/orbis_script_ui/js/tsconfig.json && cd packages/orbis_script_ui && dart run tool/embed_runtime.dart
scripts.build:scene: tsc -p packages/orbis_script_scene/js/tsconfig.json && cd packages/orbis_script_scene && dart run tool/embed_runtime.dart
